result.title: A safeguard on paper, lower scores in Experiment 005
result.description: Compare the three archived baseline runs with the three candidate runs that included a Narrative instruction intended to preserve editorial hierarchy. Explain the observed hierarchy and score differences and the decision to leave the candidate out of production.
result.audience: Readers working on editorial prompt experiments
result.rationale: The contrast between the intended safeguard and the recorded output gives a concrete account of why this candidate was not promoted. The small, non-contemporaneous samples, variation in earlier outputs and possible backend changes limit attribution.
result.evidence: Run scores: Narrative averaged 6.00 versus 4.00 and Compose 5.67 versus 3.33, baseline versus candidate. Every candidate Narrative run made orchestration central. The report records the non-promotion, the tension in baseline Synthesis, and the three-run limit.
